title: F12 narrow docs callback and revision fences
proofLimits: Trusted authored caller-supplied representations only; no original file-byte verification, OCR, file upload, server persistence, model or authorization runtime.

First ten cases use real official-SDK nested frames; last two use a direct docs consumer for local view/controlled correction preservation, explicit consent and asynchronous callback replacement fences.

Raw complete region DOM, image natural dimensions, native controls, full text/JSON, identity-scoped intents and callback counters are retained. Header validation does not prove complete image decoding.

Pinned SDK console classification is fatal on unclassified sends. No tools/context/message request, download, cookie or browser permission is allowed; ordinary requests must be owned-origin GET and fully acknowledged.

Chromium narrow touch is emulation, not physical device, exhaustive accessibility, untrusted HTML isolation or external-host proof. Browser completion is not raw socket lifecycle; process cleanup belongs to the supervisor.
